company.name: Panther
company.shortDescription: Panther is a modern SIEM platform that solves the challenges of security operations at scale
company.description:
Panther Labs provides a refreshingly practical platform for threat detection and response, powered by a highly scalable security data lake and detection-as-code. 

Panther was founded in 2018 by Jack Naglieri in San Francisco, California.

productsAndServices.description: A cloud-scale security operations platform that centralizes security data, detection engineering, alert triage, investigation, threat hunting, and response using Python-based detections and AI-assisted workflows.
productsAndServices.name: Panther AI SOC Platform

productsAndServices.description: A fully managed deployment of the Panther platform in Panther’s cloud environment, providing managed infrastructure for security data ingestion, detection, investigation, and response.
productsAndServices.name: Panther SaaS

productsAndServices.description: A customer-controlled deployment of Panther installed in the customer’s AWS environment and connected to its Snowflake or Databricks data lake, preserving customer control of security data and infrastructure.
productsAndServices.name: Cloud Connected

productsAndServices.description: Onboarding, implementation, and project-based services that help customers deploy, configure, and extend the Panther platform.
productsAndServices.name: Professional Services

productsAndServices.description: Informational and technical assistance for customers using the Panther platform, provided during the subscription term under Panther’s support terms.
productsAndServices.name: Support Services
